# Pi 1.4.0 config schemas (test fixtures)

These are unmodified copies of `schemas/models.schema.json` and `schemas/settings.schema.json`
from `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@1.4.0`, the Pi version the platform pins (npm integrity
`sha512-Z41LpZ3yYHSC/UUps6Mr39UMFPwH8elhJBG9DY1P7kuzsE5qSK/6eMj2EHzO5evJRQWLbKSqUMw+4nCNtIyiQg==`).
`fork/src/seat/pi-seat-files.test.ts` checks the rendered seat files against them. When the
pin moves, replace both files from the new package.
